Allergic contact dermatitis is a skin reaction caused by exposure to certain allergens. In construction materials like cement, metals are common culprits. ## Step 2

Cement contains hexavalent chromium (Cr(VI)), which is a strong sensitizer and a well-documented cause of allergic contact dermatitis among workers exposed to wet cement.
